Limited (40-card) — 97% of spells cast on curve — excellent, but 1 color short of Karsten target; most 2–3-land hands are keeps in a 40-card deck.

Note: in Limited (40-card), Karsten targets are scaled down from the 60-card tables (N/60) — a 2-pip spell still eats most of a draft fixing pool. Aim for ~17 lands and at most a 10/7 colour split.
